text: Registered users shall be able to log in using their email address and password.
Upon successful login, the application shall display the account dashboard to the user.
User accounts shall be locked automatically after 5 consecutive failed login attempts.
Authenticated users shall be able to transfer funds between their own bank accounts.
An SMS confirmation shall be sent to the user's registered mobile number after each successful fund transfer.
All active sessions shall expire after 15 minutes of user inactivity.
conflict_note: BANK_06 requires 15-minute expiry. BANK_09 requires 30-day persistence on trusted devices.

text: Fund transfer requests shall be processed end-to-end within 3 seconds for 95% of transactions.
conflict_note: BANK_07 requires 3-second SLA. BANK_25 adds fraud scoring that increases processing time.

text: All data transmitted between the client and server shall be encrypted using TLS 1.3 or higher.
Login sessions shall persist for 30 days on devices that the user has marked as trusted.
conflict_note: Direct conflict with BANK_06: 15-minute expiry vs 30-day persistence.

text: The login process shall be straightforward and secure for all account holders.
incomplete_note: Incomplete — straightforward and secure are undefined. No measurable criteria. LLM will flag missing_info.

text: Dashboard pages shall respond quickly under normal usage conditions.
incomplete_note: Incomplete — quickly is not quantified. No load conditions, no response time threshold defined.

text: Users shall be able to download a PDF account statement for any selected date range.
Authenticated users shall be able to initiate international wire transfers to SEPA-supported accounts.
Users shall receive an email and in-app notification within 2 minutes when a debit transaction exceeding 500 EUR is posted to their account.
Users shall be able to schedule recurring fund transfers on a daily, weekly, or monthly basis.
A scheduled transfer shall be automatically cancelled when the source account has insufficient funds at execution time.
Transaction records shall be stored in the system for compliance purposes.
incomplete_note: Incomplete — no retention period, no storage type, no regulatory reference specified.

text: A preliminary loan eligibility decision shall be returned to the applicant within 60 seconds for 90% of submissions.
Authenticated users shall be able to submit a personal loan application through the online portal.
A one-time passcode sent to the registered mobile number shall be required before any international wire transfer is processed.
conflict_note: BANK_09 allows trusted devices to bypass re-authentication. BANK_20 mandates OTP regardless of device trust.

text: Alert notifications shall be delivered to users when account activity is detected.
incomplete_note: Incomplete — no actor performing delivery, no channel specified, activity type undefined, no delivery SLA.

text: Platform availability shall be maintained at 99.95% or above, measured on a rolling 30-day basis.
All financial transaction records shall be retained in tamper-evident storage for a minimum of 7 years.
Administrator users shall be able to manually unlock a locked customer account after verifying the customer's identity.
Outgoing transfers shall be automatically blocked and the account frozen when more than 3 transfers each exceeding 1,000 EUR are detected within a 10-minute window.
conflict_note: Real-time fraud scoring adds latency that may cause BANK_07's 3-second SLA to be breached.

text: All user-facing screens shall conform to WCAG 2.1 Level AA accessibility standards.
Users shall be able to view their spending history in a suitable format.
incomplete_note: Incomplete — suitable format undefined, no time range, no categorisation specified.

text: Users shall be able to configure up to 5 monthly spending category budgets and receive an in-app alert when 80% of any budget is reached.
All REST API endpoints shall enforce OAuth 2.0 bearer token authentication and return HTTP 401 within 200 milliseconds for unauthenticated requests.
Customer support functionality shall be available within the application.
incomplete_note: Incomplete — no channel (chat/email/phone), no hours, no response SLA, no escalation path defined.
